svg.title: What to confirm, decide and prove in a Cloud PC pilot
svg.desc: Before you build, confirm four things: the user has the licenses for Windows Enterprise E3, Intune, Microsoft Entra ID P1 and Windows 365 Enterprise, a narrow Microsoft Entra pilot group with no nested groups, an administrator with the Intune Administrator or Windows 365 Administrator role, and a supported region. Then decide and record the identity, either Microsoft Entra join or hybrid join, the network, either Microsoft-hosted or an Azure network connection, and the image, either gallery or custom. Write the success result before you build: a Provisioned status, a usable session after sign in, disconnect and reconnect, and an Intune check-in with the expected join type. Save evidence at each point.
svg.text: License assignment, group members, policy target, provisioning result, first session. Remove names and IDs before you share it.
